sources.name: First Round Review
sources.why: Deep practitioner essays on coaching, 1:1s, radical candor, feedback, and behavioral management practice from working managers and VCs.

sources.name: MIT Sloan Management Review
sources.why: Research-informed articles on organizational structure, operating models, hybrid work, and org design decisions.

sources.name: The Pragmatic Engineer
sources.why: High-density breakdowns of how Big Tech scales engineering teams, management layers, and leadership at scale.

sources.name: Engineering Leadership
sources.why: Practical field notes on scaling teams, org change, and engineering leadership transitions.

sources.name: The Engineering Manager
sources.why: Newsletter on the craft of engineering management: staffing, promotion paths, and team scaling.

sources.name: Product & Leadership
sources.why: Focused essays on the intersection of product management and leadership practice.

sources.name: Product at Scale
sources.why: Newsletter on scaling product organizations, team topology, and product leadership cadence.

sources.name: Customer Obsessed Engineering (Zac Beckman)
sources.why: Essays on engineering leadership, customer-centric team design, and building high-performing product teams.

sources.name: Academy of Management
sources.why: Top scholarly journals (AMJ, AMR) on management and organizational theory — first-principles research foundation.

registries.name: OpenAlex
registries.why: Open scholarly metadata API for discovering research on leadership, org design, and management — bypasses bot-protected journal HTML.

notes: Initial discovery list (no prior round). Excluded all blacklisted domains (feed.podbean.com, feeds.feedburner.com, longform.asmartbear.com, makemeacto.substack.com, medium.com, qaspire.com, ravi-mehta.com, slack.engineering). Boundary kept clean: no HR compliance, no generic career-advice columns. Source-type mix = independent blog (4), newsletter (3), journal (3), podcast (1), academic (1), API/registry (1) — well above the ≥4 minimum. Bot-protection notes: lethain.com and hbr.org resolve but block feed probes; hbr.org should use a headline-feed fallback, lethain.com is pointed at its /feeds/ endpoint. manager-tools.com blocks feed probes — treat as podcast endpoint via an aggregator. Two verified feeds at review.firstround.com/glossary/rss/ and engineeringleadership.tech/index.xml. OpenAlex API (api.openalex.org) is the reliable crawl endpoint for academic sources.
